title: Yellow Spiced Indian Fish Biryani
description: A flavorful and aromatic Hyderabadi dish featuring fish, spices, and basmati rice, cooked to perfection in a tandoor clay pot. This recipe is pescatarian-friendly and serves one.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor clay pot by placing it in a preheated oven at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 10 minutes.
Mix the flour, cumin seeds, coriander powder, turmeric powder, and salt in a small bowl.
Coat the fish fillets with the flour mixture, shaking off any excess.
Heat the ghee in the preheated tandoor clay pot over medium heat, then add the coated fish fillets and cook until golden brown on both sides.
Remove the fish from the pot and set it aside on a plate.
Add the pickle, basmati rice, and water to the pot, stirring gently to combine.
Return the fish to the pot, cover it with a lid, and transfer it to the oven to bake at 375 degrees Fahrenheit for 20 minutes.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Fluff the biryani gently with a fork and serve hot.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
